review_reference: Backend release backend-40654084217-1-c309822bf676f096 from production-backend-images run 40654084217 (D-Eminence/hid-system#125 at 8ceef6f, migration 0093, deployed 2026-10-28). That release deployed all twelve services at 8ceef6f, so every pin moves to it. Browser-facing changes since the previous pins: patients sign in and reset with an email, phone or Health ID; POST /api/v1/auth/patient/google signs in a patient whose verified Google email matches exactly one account and answers GOOGLE_NOT_REGISTERED (404), GOOGLE_LINK_REQUIRED (409) or GOOGLE_ACCOUNT_EXISTS (409) otherwise; sign-up takes international phones in E.164; new inbox notices SECURITY_PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED, SECURITY_PASSWORD_CHANGED, SECURITY_GOOGLE_LINKED and CONSENT_GRANT_ENDED_BY_CLINICIAN; new GET /api/v1/identity/me/notifications/unread-count and GET /api/v1/identity/me/access-log. This frontend (D-Eminence/health#25, merged as 27c958f) uses each where it is answered and keeps working without. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-28 (batch approval for this parity work).
